summary: Shows the current count of consecutive days and, optionally, the personal best.
whenToUse: Showing a daily streak or a record already calculated by the application.
whenNotToUse: Calculating, incrementing, or persisting an activity streak.
accessibility: The title is a heading and the counts are visible text, not conveyed by color or icon alone.
Numbers are formatted according to the active locale; singular/plural labels are configurable.
responsive: The container shrinks to its parent and the values stay readable.
customization: Uses --dc-* tokens; className and HTML attributes are forwarded to the section.
commonMistakes: Using the component to track events or manage a streak: values are provided by the application.
limits: Does not track, calculate, or persist streaks.
